en: The soldier head is chestnut brown with blackish brown mandibles and a pronotum slightly paler than the head. It is rectangular with parallel sides and a straight hind margin. The fontanelle is a small flat pore and the labrum semicircular. Mandibles are stout with nearly straight tips and a visible basal peak. Antennae are broken, and the antennal covers are large but do not span the sides of the head. The pronotum is kidney shaped with two long setae on the disc.
soldier: 兵蚁头部栗褐色，上颚黑褐色，前胸背板色较头稍淡，头壳毛稀。头壳长方形，两侧平行，后缘中央平直。囟小，呈平坦的孔状，距额缘零点七三毫米。上唇半圆形。触角已断，触角窝盖片较大而未盖满头两侧。后颏宽区中央似有点突，腰区宽长。上颚粗壮，末端稍直，颚基峰可见。前胸背板肾形，前缘宽V形凹入，两侧缘与后缘连成半圆形，后缘中央凹入不明显，中区长毛两根，间杂少数短毛。
